name: Tale of Pygolampida
source:
You were lost. Actually no,  you were  very lost.

While trying to find your way out, you stumble upon a beautiful meadow-- literally. You lost your footing and  rolled down.

And in front of you was... some non-human creature, pointing a weapon at you...

[from [url=https://kloudinthesky.itch.io/tale-of-pygolampida]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你迷路了。其实不，你很失落。

当你试图寻找出路时，你偶然发现了一片美丽的草地——毫不夸张地说。你失去了立足点并滚了下来。

而在你面前的是……某个非人类生物，用武器指着你……

[来自[url=https://kloudinthesky.itch.io/tale-of-pygolampida]itch.io[/url]]
